Penal Code, ·1860: ss.364, 302, 201 r/w s.34- Conviction C based on circumstantial evidence - Last seen theory - PW- 1, mother of victim-deceased lodged FIR alleging that seven days back, accused persons picked up her son, beat him up and took him away and her son did not return home after arrested who took the police to the D borewell where the dead body of deceased was hidden - Courts below convicted accused no. 1 to 3 but acquitted • accused no.4 and 5 - On appeal, held: As per PW-1, deceased was last seen in temple in the company of accused Nos. 1 to 4 - As per PW-2,
